title: Settings
description: Manage your profile, account, and preferences.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Update your public information shown on your profile.
profile.publicDescription: Your name, bio, and avatar as seen by other users.
profile.linksDescription: Your website and social media handles shown on your public profile.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.themeDescription: Choose how the interface appearance is selected.
preferences.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the interface.
preferences.timezoneDescription: Choose your timezone for displaying dates and times. Leave on Auto to use your browser's timezone.

account.title: Account
account.description: Manage your email address, username, and account information.
account.emailDescription: Your login email. You will need to re-confirm if you change it.
account.usernameDescription: Your unique handle used in your public profile URL (e.g. tidycards.app/yourname).
account.emailNotConfirmedCaption: Your email address is not confirmed yet.
account.resendConfirmationSent: Confirmation email sent. Please check your inbox.
account.resendConfirmationFailed: Failed to send confirmation email. Please try again.
account.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete your account, all your lists, and all your data. This action cannot be undone.
account.deleteFailed: Account deletion failed. Please try again.

security.title: Password & authentication
security.description: Manage your password and future authentication methods (OAuth, passkeys, 2FA).
security.passwordDescription: Choose a strong password you don't use elsewhere.
security.authMethodsDescription: Additional sign-in methods will be available here soon.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Control how and when you receive notifications.

saveFailed: Failed to save settings. Please try again.
